code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    marker = next(v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != bg and sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) == 1)
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, marker)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    pat=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==marker:
                top=r-len(pat)//2; left=c-len(pat[0])//2
                for dr,row in enumerate(pat):
                    for dc,v in enumerate(row):
                        if v != bg and 0<=top+dr<h and 0<=left+dc<w: out[top+dr][left+dc]=v
    return out
'''
